steam:3041230.curatorWhy: The most direct pirate-survival match for this request: a personal base, a ship, exploration, crafting and land/sea combat. Still Early Access, with separate storefronts and evolving systems.

steam:440900.curatorWhy: For the Conan side of your taste: monumental bases, dangerous expeditions and character progression in a brutal fantasy setting. Choose solo, PvE co-op or competitive servers deliberately.

steam:2399830.curatorWhy: For spectacular creature collecting, taming and ambitious bases. The newer ARK edition is demanding and its reception is mixed, so performance and server choice matter more than the screenshot appeal.
steam:2399830.recommendationCaution: Mixed or weak aggregate reception. Included for breadth and specific mechanics, not among the safest purchases; inspect recent reviews before buying.

steam:346110.curatorWhy: The older, content-heavy ARK route. Keep its ecosystem and purchases separate from Survival Ascended rather than assuming an upgrade or cross-compatible saves.

steam:892970.curatorWhy: A particularly strong long-term world for a small group: build a settlement, prepare expeditions and steadily push into more dangerous biomes. Its original Early Access release was in 2021.

steam:1203620.curatorWhy: A strong choice when building and adventurous exploration matter as much as eating and drinking. Handcrafted fantasy discovery with an unusually expressive construction system.

steam:1623730.curatorWhy: For creature-assisted production, collecting and cooperative base-building. A lighter systemic direction than hard wilderness simulation, with its development status kept visible.

steam:2646460.curatorWhy: For the tribe-management side of Conan: recruit people, develop a settlement and explore a dangerous world. More systems-heavy than a simple gather-and-build loop.

steam:427410.curatorWhy: A standout co-op change of setting: improvise a home and equipment inside a strange research facility rather than another familiar forest.

steam:962130.curatorWhy: A backyard becomes an enormous survival world. Especially appealing for carefully designed exploration, distinctive creatures and creative bases.

steam:264710.curatorWhy: One of the strongest exploration-first survival choices: build the equipment that lets you reach the next depth, then discover why you should be afraid of it. The original is single-player.

steam:648800.curatorWhy: For turning a tiny floating platform into a moving home with friends. The old itch.io prototype is labelled separately from the much larger commercial release.

steam:1564600.curatorWhy: A compelling lesser-known choice for tactile, demanding survival and settlement work. Better suited to deliberate preparation than fast arcade resource gathering.

steam:1857950.curatorWhy: For a first-person, systems-heavy zombie sandbox with building and scavenging. Inspect its Early Access status and player feedback before expecting a finished Zomboid replacement.

steam:2353250.curatorWhy: A good hidden-gem direction for players who want Subnautica-style progression in space: gather, craft and expand a base around the needs of exploration.

steam:2570210.curatorWhy: For cooperative restoration and large-scale transformation of a hostile planet, with automation and crafting as the route forward.

steam:951440.curatorWhy: A mobile drilling machine gives the usual survival base a purpose and a personality. Explore, manufacture and retreat underground instead of defending a static cabin.

steam:1374490.curatorWhy: A recognizable fantasy setting with survival construction, magic and cooperative expeditions. Kept separate from the main RuneScape MMO.

steam:105600.curatorWhy: The reference point for 2D survival progression: a dig becomes a mine, a mine becomes an expedition, and every boss opens more crafting possibilities.

steam:1621690.curatorWhy: For the Terraria feeling from a top-down perspective: mining, food, equipment, bosses and a shared underground home.

steam:1169040.curatorWhy: For a Terraria-like adventure with a settlement that can work alongside you. A strong choice for people who like both expedition progress and managing a growing home.

steam:211820.curatorWhy: For a broader, more exploratory 2D sandbox with planets, building and a large community. Treat its current development and mod compatibility separately from newer games.

steam:315460.curatorWhy: A smaller, focused 2D survival option where the engineering and defense of your base really matter, rather than building purely for decoration.

steam:876650.curatorWhy: A compact-looking game that grows into a surprisingly broad mining, crafting and exploration adventure. Good when you want clear progression rather than a completely directionless sandbox.

steam:324080.curatorWhy: A detailed building-focused sandbox for players who enjoy shaping terrain and constructing ambitious homes. Follow the current edition notes as its technology and content evolve.

steam:382310.curatorWhy: An unusually social building world where a shared economy and ecological consequences matter. A deliberate community project rather than an uncomplicated solo Minecraft substitute.

steam:2253100.curatorWhy: A newer floating-island voxel adventure with survival and construction. Worth investigating for the Minecraft-like shelf, with its Early Access limitations visible.

steam:2776090.curatorWhy: A newer block-world discovery centered on a world you can reshape. Particularly relevant to the request, while current reception and sample size remain visible.

steam:3495730.curatorWhy: An unusual, dreamlike block-world direction rather than a conventional realistic survival game. Explore its trailer before assuming it has the tone of Minecraft or Vintage Story.

steam:3516590.curatorWhy: A newer voxel-sandbox discovery for the dedicated Minecraft-like section. Its creator support page is separate from the game purchase.

steam:1072420.curatorWhy: For building with a strong campaign and a charming world rather than pure hunger pressure. An explicitly labelled sandbox-adventure neighbor with clear creative goals.

steam:233860.curatorWhy: A harsh, open-ended squad RPG where survival stories emerge from the world. Not first-person crafting, but an excellent deep-systems detour.

steam:1963610.curatorWhy: For tense survival expeditions and careful equipment management. Creator support, public development builds and the current full-game edition are distinguished.
